highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.3 is a stable servicing release that records the end of the Chrome M151 release line.

bullets.detail: Closes the M151 release line after the upstream Chrome branch retired, keeping the bundled Skia engine's release tracking current.

v4.151.3.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.3 closes the stable M151 release line.
v4.151.3.body: This servicing release records the upstream Chrome branch retirement for the bundled Skia engine.
